Chapter 116: No Suspense Over Who Peking University's Campus Belle Is

"Good evening, viewers. Today is... Welcome to this episode of 'Peking University News.' Rooted in Yan Garden, we transmit the voice of our times; with pen as our vessel, we stir the long river of thought. This episode's main stories are—"

"The University Party Committee..."

"Peking University team publishes XX, achieving a breakthrough in..."

"The Centennial Hall stages an original play..."

"Chen Guiliang, a student from the 2004 Yuanpei Program, has received seed funding for his incubation project at Peking University Science Park..."

"That's all for today's 'Peking University News.' Recording our growth through news, and witnessing our glory through the lens. Thank you for watching..."

The Peking University Television Station program was transmitted via a closed-circuit network, with TV terminals in public areas across campus.

Many dorm buildings also had televisions, though it varied. Building 36, where Chen Guiliang lived, did not.

"Phew."

Only after the camera shut off did Li Shishi let out a long breath, her tense muscles finally relaxing.

The male anchor, a second-year senior, comforted her, "It's always like this when you first start hosting the news. It's normal to be a little nervous. You'll get used to it."

"Thank you for the encouragement, senior," Li Shishi said with a smile.

The senior then asked her out to dinner, which Li Shishi politely declined.

She went to the cafeteria alone, then strolled slowly back to her dorm. As soon as she walked in, she heard her roommate say, "Shishi, come quick and look!"

"Look at what?" Li Shishi asked.

"The campus belle poll! You're second place in the School of Journalism and Communication right now!"

A three-round voting process was too complicated, so when the event was actually launched, it was simplified to a two-tier system.

First, they would elect the department belle—or more accurately, the school belle, but everyone was used to calling them department belles.

The top three vote-getters from each school and department would be displayed on the campus belle election page after a delay.

Each user could cast two votes per day: one for their own school or department, and one on the main event page.

Li Shishi was completely baffled. "What campus belle poll?"

Her roommate said, "It was launched by Xiaonei. They even posted on BBS to promote it. A lot of students are on BBS asking for registration invitation codes just so they can vote for the girls in their department."

Li Shishi leaned in to look at the computer and saw that she was indeed in second place in her school.

And she was a long way behind first place.

The first-place winner was Liu Xuan, an Olympic champion, retired athlete, and movie star.

Li Shishi didn't know whether to laugh or cry. "What's the point of voting? No one can compare to her. Liu Xuan is definitely number one."

"That's not fair. Liu Xuan is too famous," her roommate said.

ByteDance, company office.

Chen Guiliang and his partners looked at each other in dismay. They had completely overlooked Liu Xuan.

The Olympic champion and big movie star had been very low-key since enrolling. She was often mentioned in her first year, but by the second year, people had gotten used to it. Now, many freshmen didn't even know she was at Peking University.

"No suspense at all," Guo Feng said.

"The vote count is a landslide," Ao Yanchen said. "The follow-up posts can only focus on promoting the department belles from each school."

Chen Guiliang said, "As long as it's effective."

The Peking University campus belle election had ended as soon as it began.

Liu Xuan was 100% the winner!

Perhaps there were girls prettier than her, but her fame alone was enough to attract countless votes.

Dong Qianqiu suddenly interjected, "I think this event is a great success."

"User growth is indeed fast, and engagement is up. People are starting to use all sorts of features," Guo Feng agreed.

Wearing a smug expression, Dong Qianqiu moved the mouse, admiring the photos of the beautiful women. "Don't you guys think this is like an emperor choosing his concubines? Every user is an emperor, and clicking the mouse is like flipping a nameplate. The campus belle is the empress, and the department belles are the concubines."

Guo Feng said with disdain, "Vulgar!"

Ao Yanchen said, "Disgusting!"

They all turned to look at Chen Guiliang.

Chen Guiliang said with a straight face, "You may all continue. We are selecting consorts. Do not disturb."

Chen Guiliang was indeed having a great time flipping through the "nameplates." He hadn't expected to see a familiar face like Li Shishi, in addition to Liu Xuan.

The Spring Festival Gala.

While Chen Guiliang was browsing photos of beautiful women, Ao Yanchen, who was temporarily acting as customer service, burst out laughing at his computer.

"What's wrong?"

"Someone filed a complaint, saying we're discriminating against Sister Furong by not giving her a voting spot."

On Peking University's Weiming BBS, a post was being pushed to the top.

"Who is the Real Peking University Campus Belle?"

The title alone attracted countless clicks.

"Not long ago, I read a report. Li Ying, a senior from the class of '88, earned 10 million yuan in three years. This year, she beat out more than 2,000 distributors to become the first to secure a BMW dealership. She was selected as one of Asia's Most Stylish and Charming Women of 2004 and has been dubbed the 'Peking University Campus Belle' by multiple media outlets..."

"Admittedly, Senior Li Ying is outstanding, but she graduated twelve years ago. Who should our campus belle be now? With this question in mind, we at ByteDance decided to launch a campus belle poll on Xiaonei. The rules are as follows..."

This post received replies almost instantly.

"First!"

"Second!"

"I object! Why can't we nominate Sister Furong?"

"Exactly, Sister Furong is the true Peking University Campus Belle!"

"Are the two of you upstairs disgusting or what?"

After a hundred replies.

"Damn, visitors can't vote, and you need an invitation code to register."

"Willing to pay big for an invitation code. Will treat to a meal outside the south gate."

"Can anyone with an invitation code send me one? I want to vote for Bai Yufei from our class."

"Forget it, it's pointless. The first-place winner has more than three times the votes of the second. It's a competition with no suspense."

"Haha, I voted for Liu Xuan too."

"The event page has been updated. The top three from each school and department are listed on the main page as department belle candidates."

"I can't believe it. How is Zhou Tong number one in our department? Yan Shuqi is clearly prettier than her; it's just a bad photo for the event. Can someone give me an invitation code? I need to go vote for Yan Shuqi!"

This time, the Peking University campus belle election had gone completely off track.

Everyone felt there was no suspense as to who the campus belle would be, and instead shifted their attention to the department belles.

A flood of new posts appeared on Peking University's BBS, with more than half of them asking for invitation codes.

This led to students who didn't know about the campus belle election passively receiving information about it, and learning about a website called Xiaonei, a site you couldn't just register for.

The number of registered users skyrocketed!

Besides voting, they were also exploring other features, discovering that in addition to uploading photos and writing journals, they could also create and join various groups.

Someone would be writing a blog in their journal when they'd suddenly receive an internal message—an invitation from a club officer to join their group.

Others would be browsing the list of groups for their university, and scrolling through, they'd find things like "Graduate Entrance Exam Study Group," "Lakeside Reading Club," "Sanguosha Players," and so on, and would joyfully apply to join the ones that interested them.

Chen Guiliang himself received many group invitations, such as "2004 Yuanpei Program" and "Classical Poetry Appreciation Society."

At night, Chen Guiliang rode his bicycle back to the dorm, and surprisingly, Senior Min and Jiang Junlai were there.

They were currently huddled in front of the computer, craning their necks and staring intently at the screen.

"You guys are back early today," Chen Guiliang said. "Watching porn?"

"You're the one watching porn!"

Not wanting to be unfairly accused, Jiang Junlai explained, "We're looking at the campus belle and department belles."

Chen Guiliang was very pleased.

The event was truly captivating, managing to make his two studious roommates cut their study time short and rush back to the dorm.

Min Wenyu said, "The girls from the School of Journalism and Communication are really high quality. Not to mention the first-place Liu Xuan and second-place Li Shishi, even the third-place Tang Menglan could be a department belle in any other school."

"I think Li Shishi is prettier than Liu Xuan. She looks so pure and innocent," Jiang Junlai said.
